claims.text: Herubrand was presumably one of the Riders of Rohan who rode with their King Théoden from Rohan to Gondor. He fought and died in the Battle of the Pelennor Fields on 15 March, . His name is remembered in the poem Song of the Mounds of Mundburg.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "The Battle of the Pelennor Fields", p. 849; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Great Years", entry for the year 3019, March 15, p. 1094
